template.label: Farm outreach
template.description: Reach local farms, ranches and growers listed on u9itus: a postcard, a call from our team when it lands, and a follow-up email inviting them to claim their page.
notes: DRAFT COPY: settle the offer and wording before the first real send.
Lives in campaign_templates/, not campaigns/, so it never runs as a house campaign (docs/U9ITUS_CAMPAIGN_ORDERS.md section 3).
Same play as campaigns/u9itus-hybrid-local: mail, then a person calls, then email (docs/MAILER_FOLLOWUP_CALLS.md).
u9itus_categories values are a guess; confirm them against u9itus's businesses.category before use.

placeholders.[[name]]: Filled once, when a campaign is made from this template, from params below.
placeholders.{{name}}: Filled per prospect at send time (core/pipeline.py _build_variables): org_name, contact_first, city, state, your_name, your_email, source_url.

mail_00_postcard.front:
{{org_name}} IS ON U9ITUS
Buyers near {{city}} can find your farm
mail_00_postcard.back:
Hi {{contact_first}},

{{org_name}} has a page on u9itus, where restaurants,
markets and neighbors in {{city}} look for local growers.
Claim it to keep your hours, products and contact right.

See it: {{source_url}}

We'll give you a quick call in a few days.
— {{your_name}}, {{your_email}}

phone_00_mailer_followup.title: Farm Mailer Follow-Up — Did the postcard arrive?
phone_00_mailer_followup.goal: Confirm the right contact and get permission to email the claim link
phone_00_mailer_followup.body:
── BEFORE YOU DIAL ──────────────────────────────────────

[Contact: {{contact_name}}, {{contact_title}}]
[Their u9itus page: {{source_url}}]
[Farmers are often in the field midday: try early morning or late afternoon.]
[Ask the Call Coach agent on the prospect page for a one-paragraph prep.]

── OPENING ──────────────────────────────────────────────

"Hi, is this {{contact_name}}? This is {{your_name}} with u9itus. We mailed
{{org_name}} a postcard last week about your farm's page on u9itus. Did it
make it to you?"

[If no: "No problem. It's the page buyers near {{city}} see when they look for
local growers. Could I email you the link instead? What's the best address?"]

── IF THEY'RE INTERESTED ───────────────────────────────

"Great. I'll email you the link to claim it today. You can list what you grow,
when it's in season and how buyers reach you."
[Log: interest high or medium, next step "send claim link".]

── IF IT'S A BAD TIME ──────────────────────────────────

"Totally understand, I'll keep it short. Can I just email you the link?"

── IF NOT ───────────────────────────────────────────────

"Understood, thanks for your time."
[If they ask not to be called: log "Asked not to be called again".]

01_after_call.subject: {{org_name}}'s page on u9itus
01_after_call.body:
Hi {{contact_first}},

Following up on the postcard we sent {{org_name}}. Here is your farm's page
on u9itus:

{{source_url}}

Claim it to list what you grow, when it's in season and how buyers near
{{city}} can reach you. Happy to answer questions, just reply to this email.

{{your_name}}

02_last_note.subject: Last note about {{org_name}} on u9itus
